cases.title: Level 1 Priority: Deficit Tier 0 Beats Deficit Tier 1 Regardless of Score
cases.description: Candidate A (Tier 0, 0 deficits, score 250) vs Candidate B (Tier 1, 1 deficit, score 450). Blueprint mandates Tier 0 ranks ahead of Tier 1.
cases.audit_finding: CRITICAL FLAW: In candidate_leaderboard_view, both candidates have ranking_tier = 1 and unmet_requirements = 0. SQL sorts by smart_score DESC, causing Candidate B (450 pts) to erroneously win!

cases.title: Level 1 Priority: Deficit Tier 1 Beats Deficit Tier 2 Regardless of Score
cases.description: Candidate A (Tier 1, 1 deficit, score 280) vs Candidate B (Tier 2, 2 deficits, score 480).
cases.audit_finding: CRITICAL FLAW: SQL view collapses Tier 1 and Tier 2, ranking purely by smart_score DESC.

cases.title: Level 2 Priority: Same Tier, Score Breaks Tie
cases.description: Both Candidate A and B are Tier 0. Candidate A has score 350; Candidate B has score 300.
cases.audit_finding: Within the same deficit tier, higher smart_score wins in both Blueprint and SQL.

cases.title: Level 3 Priority: Same Tier & Score, Walkability (weighted_radial_dist) Breaks Tie
cases.description: Both Candidate A and B are Tier 0 with smart_score 350. Candidate A has weighted_radial_dist = 185.4m; Candidate B has 242.1m.
cases.audit_finding: CRITICAL FLAW: weighted_radial_dist is not in the SQL view or ORDER BY clause; tie is broken arbitrarily by candidate string ID.

cases.title: Level 4 Priority: Same Tier, Score & Radial, Origin Distance Breaks Tie
cases.description: Both candidates match on Tier 0, smart_score 350, and weighted_radial 200.0m. Candidate A is at (C_X, C_Z) = (32, 32) (dist 45.25m). Candidate B is at (128, 128) (dist 181.02m).
cases.audit_finding: CRITICAL FLAW: Origin distance is not in the SQL view or ORDER BY clause; tie is broken arbitrarily by candidate string ID.
